task.title: Wire T1/T2/T4 bridge builders to emit AppraisalInput and return AppraisalOutput
task.objective: Refactor the three active bridge builders (build_signal_from_t1_world_tick, build_signal_from_t2_influencer_tick, build_signal_from_t4_relationship_tick) so that each one constructs an AppraisalInput, passes it through AppraisalOutput.from_deterministic_fallback (or a per-tick translation layer), and returns an AppraisalOutput instead of an AppraisalSignal. Add a thin adapter that converts an AppraisalOutput to the existing AppraisalSignal so that simulate_day_bridged can continue to call _apply_bridge_signal unchanged. All existing 441 tests must continue to pass.
task.exact_scope: The refactor is limited to tick_bridge.py. The three signal-builder functions listed above must produce an AppraisalOutput as their primary return value. A new conversion helper (appraisal_output_to_signal) must translate AppraisalOutput to AppraisalSignal for the existing settlement path. The simulate_day_bridged orchestrator must wire each builder call through the new boundary: builder -> AppraisalOutput -> appraisal_output_to_signal -> AppraisalSignal -> _apply_bridge_signal. No changes to appraisal_settlement.py, day_simulator.py, appraisal_output.py, appraisal_input.py, or any test file. No new settlement logic. No changes to AppraisalSignal field definitions.
acceptance_criteria: build_signal_from_t1_world_tick returns an AppraisalOutput with fallback_used=True, confidence=1.0, tick_type=EventCategory.information_exposure, and signal fields matching the existing T1 mapping rules.

build_signal_from_t2_influencer_tick returns an AppraisalOutput with fallback_used=True, confidence=1.0, tick_type=EventCategory.social_interaction, and signal fields matching the existing T2 mapping rules.

build_signal_from_t4_relationship_tick returns an AppraisalOutput (or None) with fallback_used=True, confidence=1.0, tick_type=EventCategory.relationship_shift, and signal fields matching the existing T4 mapping rules for all three activation paths (default reinforcement, qualifying event, Pattern A, Pattern B).

A conversion helper appraisal_output_to_signal(output: AppraisalOutput) -> AppraisalSignal exists in tick_bridge.py and produces a structurally identical AppraisalSignal to the one the old builders produced for the same inputs.
simulate_day_bridged calls each builder, receives an AppraisalOutput, calls appraisal_output_to_signal, and passes the result to _apply_bridge_signal exactly as before.
All 441 existing tests pass without modification.
The three builder functions each construct an AppraisalInput as an intermediate object before producing their AppraisalOutput, making the boundary visible in the call graph.
The AppraisalInput constructed for T1 has tick_type=information_exposure, no relational_context, and no player_context.
The AppraisalInput constructed for T2 has tick_type=social_interaction and a populated relational_context.

The AppraisalInput constructed for T4 has tick_type=relationship_shift and a populated relational_context when a relationship is found; the function returns None early (before constructing AppraisalInput) when no relationship exists.
required_tests: A new test module (test_p29_t4_bridge_boundary.py) must verify that build_signal_from_t1_world_tick returns an AppraisalOutput instance, not an AppraisalSignal.
A new test must verify that build_signal_from_t2_influencer_tick returns an AppraisalOutput instance.
A new test must verify that build_signal_from_t4_relationship_tick returns an AppraisalOutput when a relationship is found, and None when none is found.
A new test must verify that appraisal_output_to_signal produces a valid AppraisalSignal with fields equal to the corresponding fields on the source AppraisalOutput.
A new test must verify that the AppraisalOutput returned by each of the three builders carries fallback_used=True and confidence=1.0.
A new test must verify that the tick_type field on each builder's output echoes the expected EventCategory.

A new test must verify that the T1 builder output's absorption, valence, arousal, growth, relational, and aftershock_days fields are identical to what the old build_signal_from_t1_world_tick produced for the same aligned and non-aligned inputs.
A new test must verify that the T2 builder output's relational block (trust_shift, closeness_delta) matches the old T2 signal for both the high-influence and low-influence cases.

A new test must verify that the T4 builder output for the default positive reinforcement path, the confrontation path, Pattern A, and Pattern B each produce an AppraisalOutput whose appraisal_output_to_signal translation equals the expected AppraisalSignal.

All pre-existing tests in test_tick_bridge.py, test_residual_aware_bridge.py, test_residual_continuity_audit.py, test_residual_persistence.py, test_t4_social_event_detection.py, test_t4_behavior_contract.py, and test_p28_t4_comprehensive_coverage.py must pass without any changes to those files.
non_goals: Do not introduce LLM runtime or any external appraisal source.
Do not change the field definitions of AppraisalSignal v1.
Do not wire T3, T5, T6, T7, or T8 to the new boundary.
Do not alter AppraisalOutput.from_deterministic_fallback; the builders may use it as a reference but must produce equivalent output directly to avoid gratuitous indirection.
Do not modify appraisal_settlement.py, day_simulator.py, appraisal_output.py, appraisal_input.py, or deterministic_fallback.py.
Do not refactor _apply_bridge_signal or any settlement helper.
Do not change the residual-aware adjustment functions (_adjust_t1, _adjust_t2, _adjust_t4); they continue to operate on AppraisalSignal as today.
Do not add new audit record types or extend existing audit dataclasses.
Do not add or modify any API route, seed file, or frontend file.
constraints: AppraisalSignal v1 fields must not be added, removed, or renamed.
T4 old deterministic path is frozen: do not activate or introduce any new negative T4 branch beyond what already exists in build_signal_from_t4_relationship_tick.
Stage 1 deferred ticks (T3, T5, T6, T7, T8) must not receive any bridge wiring or settlement path changes.
Settlement belongs to the engine layer: AppraisalOutput is a boundary contract only; the conversion helper must translate faithfully without adding extra logic.
The fallback_used flag on AppraisalOutput must be set to True for all three builders because all current outputs are fully deterministic.
The confidence field must be set to 1.0 for all three builders.
The tick_type advisory field on AppraisalOutput must echo the EventCategory of the tick that produced the output.

The relational field on the AppraisalOutput returned by the T4 builder must be None when the builder would return None (no relationship found); the outer caller must handle the None-output case and skip settlement as before.
The relational_context slice in the AppraisalInput constructed for T2 and T4 must be populated from the actual influencer relationship data at call time.
No import of AppraisalInput or AppraisalOutput is allowed in test files that do not already import them (do not modify existing test files).

execution_evidence.summary: Refactored T1/T2/T4 bridge builders to return AppraisalOutput via an AppraisalInput intermediate, added appraisal_output_to_signal conversion helper, wired simulate_day_bridged through the new boundary, and created 37 new tests verifying the boundary contract.
